tei:div.tei:p: "$ (311)༄༅// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi rtsa yig bzhugs so//

(312)༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lhan cig skyes sbyor gdams ngag ni// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum la// dang po zla ba gcig gi bar// skyo shas drag po bskyed nas ni// gsol ba gdab cing maṇ+ḍal dbul// yi ge brgya pa brgya rtsa bzla// de la rmis ltas bzang po dang*// 'jig rten chos la blo sna bzlog /gang zag dad gus ldan pa la// rab kyis de ru sgro 'dogs chod// 'bring la nyams myong bzang po yong*// tha mas rje la dad gus skye// nyams skye ba'i rgyu ni dad pa can// skyo shas skyes pas mos gus can// byin rlabs stobs kyis shes rab can// de lta bu yis don go bas// de gsum gang ldan sngon 'gro tshar// dngos gzhi la ni rnam gnyis te// cha rkyen dang ni gdams pa'o// dang po kha zas bcud can bza'// lus rung rgyas pas sems las rung*// gnas ni dben par mtshams bcad bya// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba btang*// spyod lam gnya' shing gang tsam blta// 'gro 'dug nad pa'i spyod las bzhin// gdams ngag dngos la rnam (313)gsum ste// dang po rtog pa bkag nas bsgom// de la rlung can rlung med gnyis// rlung ni bum can thun bzhir bsgom// rlung med rten can rten med gnyis// rten ni shing bu rde'u dang*// mar me bla ma dag la gtad// rten med ma bcos ngang la bzhag /bar skabs sgrung rgyud snyan po bshad// skyo ba skye ba'i gdams ngag bshad// rje la gsol ba ma thebs shing*// zhen pa gting nas ma log na// sgom pa bzang yang nyung ma'i g.yos// sgom skyon bying rmugs rgod pa gsum// bying na 'dug sa bseng bar bya// chu gdab bya dang bya bar bsgom// rgod na bskum ste bcud can bza'// pho rlung drag po yang yang bsgom// rmugs na glo skar ser bu bsten// rten khyad can gyi spyan snga ru// tshe rab thog ma med pa nas// bla ma dkon mchog la sogs la// sgro skur btab cing sdig bsags rnams// zhag bdun bar du bshags pa bya// de nas yang ni bskyar la bsgom// de ltar bsgoms pas nyams myong 'char// (314)bde gsal mi rtog sna tshogs 'byung*// de la dga' ba sna tshogs skye// mos gus ma bcos shugs kyis skye// zhen pa nang nas dbang med zlog

/de ni skyong yun ring tshad dka'// sgom shes mang ste bshag shes nyung*// de nas babs kyis bshig thabs ni// sgom dang rtog pa bsre ba ni// rtog pa brgyud mar ma song bar// rtsa chad bum bur sgo gseb gdab// mig kyang dang tshum mang du bya// 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug smra sogs la// yengs par med par bya ra bas// nyon mongs rnam rtog la sogs la// dgos shing med thabs med du blta// skyon can mi dang srid du bcad// des ni dgag sgrub gnyis dang bral// rnam rtog bsgom du ma shar na// gang byas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras yin// sgom chen bsgom gyis ma bcings par// go ba'i lta ba rgyab tu bskyur// bsgom pa'i nyams myong rmang nas bshig /ngo sprad ma snga rkun bur gtang*// bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*// lta sgom dag dang 'brel pa gnyis// 'jo chan rtog pa 'char ba ste// sngar 'dris mi dang de ru 'phrad// lha gsol yod na bya dgos snyam// dga' ba khyad par can yang skye// mdo rgyud bla ma'i gsung bgros dang*// ngo sprod thams cad rdzogs pa ni// rnal 'byor bzhi yis rim par bshad// 'khor bar mi ldog lung yang bsten// las 'bras rang la dgos med kyang*// gzugs sku'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir// mi bden bzhin du rten 'brel bsgrig /de nas rjes kyi gdams ngag la// bsgom skyes bdag po med pa ni// shog bu rlung gis khyer ba 'dra// yid bzhin nor bu 'dam gseb bcings// seng ge khyi yis zla la shor// rgyal po dmangs su babs pa bzhin// des na zhen log (315)bdag po dgos// rtogs pa shar ba'i rnal 'byor pa// ma bsgoms par ni las thabs tshar// lug ji lta bu'i rnal 'byor pas// mi tshe zang gis bsgom pa'am// dgu'am drug tu bsgom par bya// de yang mi tshe rtag tu blta/ rtogs pa sgyu mar ma shar bar// zhen log chos brgyad ma snyoms par// snying rjes rang don ma zad par// thabs mkhas dus la ma bab par// yon tan de tsho ldan pa na// rin chen lta bu'i gang zag la// kun gyis thod bzhin bskur bar rigs// che 'bring chung gsum 'bags tshad 'chongs/

lhan cig skyes sbyor gnad gsum ldan gyi man ngag rdzogs so/// dge'o// shu bhaṃ// maṅga laṃ// ༈ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi gzhung chung bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas dri med 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*// blo bur dri mas btang bas zag med sku/ rten 'brel chos las 'das pas dag pa'i dbyings// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// gdod nas rang la gnas pas lhan cig skyes// rgyu rkyen gnyis med rang byung chos kyi dbyings// bsam brjod yul las 'das pas rtog yul min// zab mo mtshon pa'i gdams pa 'dir bshad bya// kye ho bsags sbyang gnyis 'dir chos kun 'dus// dngos gzhi bzhi la sbyor ba rjes kyi chos// sngon 'gro drug la nyin mtshan rtag tu 'bad// rtags bzhi rdzogs tshe 'dod yon lhun gyis grub// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde ba che// bla ma'i drin las rtogs par 'gyur ba'i phyir// rgyun du bla ma'i mos gus gnad du bsnun// de yi byin rlabs snying la 'jug par 'gyur// rang gi lus la ye shes chen po gnas// de las gzhan du rnyed par nus min pas// chos bdun ldan pa'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas pas// rnam par mi rtog ye shes (316)ngang gis skye// de nyid don la sems pa'i rnal 'byor pas// phyag dang bskor ba kha 'don lha bsgom pa// gnas lugs don las g.yel phyir spang bar bya// bag yod dran shes spyod lam nyid la gnas/ byang chub shing dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten// steng 'og thig le snying ga'i sa bon la// ma yengs mi bsgom so ma'i ngang du bzhag /thun gyi gdams pas 'dor len gnad du bsnun// rdo rje'i bzlas pa srog rtsol rlung bcing zhing*// sgrim dang glod pas rig pa g.yo med bcing*// rang sar bzhag la yengs med dran pa brten// chos kyi spyod pa dran pa'i so pas skyong*// ri gzar chu dang gang gā rgya mtsho bzhin// rab 'bring tha ma gnas pa'i skye tshul te// mi rtog bde gsal nyams kyi 'char sgo sogs// zhi gnas nyams kyi skye tshul shes par bya// kye ho nyi zla g.yo med nam mkhar bcing*// sems 'di ma bcos sor bzhag rang lugs la// sgom med yengs med rig pa ngar ldan pas// skye ba med pas chos nyid don la blta// rang gis rang ngo shes pa'i chos nyid de// dbyibs dang kha dog med pas mtshon du med// gsal rig stong gsum gshis kyi gnas lugs de// gar du ma grub mtha' bral bde ba che// rnam rtog gang shar ma yeng de la blta// gnas dang mi gnas gnyug ma'i ngang du gcig

/sprin tshogs 'thug kyang nam mkha' las ma 'das// skye 'gag gnas med stong gsal rig par bzhugs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug nyid la blta// gsal la ngos bzung med pa dug gsum gshis// rang bzhin rang ngo shes pas ma spangs dag /dug gis dug 'joms nyon mongs chen po yi// sgo lnga yul thogs yid dang bral bar bzhag /'dzin sems med pas yul (317)snang rang sar dag /bsal bzhag med kyang gshis lugs stong pa yin// yin lugs rtogs pas snang sems dbyer med 'dres// chos nyid don la 'di bsgom dmigs su med// sgom mkhan stong na sgom med ngang du grol// spang blang med pa thams cad gcig tu 'dres// bsgom pa sgom med tha mal ngang na bde// dran pa'i rang bzhin ye nas chos kyi dbyings// dran mkhan shes pas dran pa rang sar dag /dran stong dus mnyam rjes thob lam gyi gnad// kun las khyad 'phags mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig yin// rang byung yin pas skye 'gag gnas gsum bral// kha dog dbyibs kyi rdzas med rtag mtha' bral// gsal zhing rig pas med pa'i mtha' ma lhung*// 'gyur ba med pas dge sdig las gnyis kyis/ phan dang gnod pa mi 'gyur rdzas med phyir// dge dang sdig pa ma grub gnod byed med// las dang las 'bras rmi lam bde sdug bzhin// nga bdag med pas sgrib dang bcing ba med// spang byas dben pas bcings las grol ba med// 'od gsal nyid la rgyun chad med pa yi// dran par khrid na mnyam rjes gnyis su med// spyod lam kun tu 'dun pa'i lcag gis bskul// de la goms na nyams rtogs 'khor mar 'byung*// tha mal shes pa ma bcos phyag rgya che// snang srid chos rnams snang dus nyid nas stong*// gang shar stong pa nyid las mi 'da' zhing*// ma byas lhun grub zung 'jug gshis lugs yin/ sems dang kun gzhi bde gshegs snying po dang*// rang byung ye shes chos nyid chos dbyings dang*// de bzhin nyid dang stong nyid 'od gsal dang*/

zung 'jug yang dag don dam rnam grangs nyid// stong pa rig pa gsal ba rnam pa gsum// re re'i steng du de gsum dbyer med par// (318)lhan cig skyes pas lhan skyes ye shes te// gdod nas rang la lhan cig sbyor ba byas// 'od gsal nyid las sangs rgyas sems can gnyis// khyad par med cing sems nyid sangs rgyas te// rang gis rang ma rtogs pas ma rig 'khrul// rang sems rang gis rtogs pa sangs rgyas yin// sems ma rtogs pas khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams// rang sems rtogs pas sangs rgyas chos kyi sku// 'khor 'das gnyis po sems kyi ldog cha ste// kun gyi gzhi ni byang chub sems yin no// sems nyid gcig nyid 'khor 'das gnyis su shar// sems nyid rtogs na 'khor ba ma spangs par// mya ngan 'das pa ma bsgrubs lhun gyis grub// chos kyi dbyings la 'khor 'das dbyer mi phyed// kha dog dbyibs med tshogs drug yul las 'das// gsal zhing rig pas bde sdug nyams su myong*// skye 'gag med pas 'dus ma byas phyir rtag /yul dang yul can gcig dang tha dad bral// dben pa'i gnas su 'du 'dzi kun spangs te// chos bdun ldan pa'i gang zag dag gis bsgom// yengs med sgom med dus gsum rtog pa spang*// shes pa ma bcos gang ltar 'dug sar bzhag /yengs med mi rtog spro bsdu med par bya// ma bying ma ltengs ngar dang ldan par bsgom// gang shar rtog pa ngos bzung de la blta// nyon mongs skyes pa'i rang bzhin shes par bya// sgo lnga'i yul la spong 'gegs mi byed par// gang shar thog tu ma bcos so mar bzhag /za 'chag nyal sogs spyod lam dus kun tu// dran pa'i bya ras yengs pa med par skyong*// chu bo'i rgyun dang mar me'i rtse mo bzhin// nyin dang mtshan du rtse gcig mnyam par bzhag /gnas lugs rtogs nas spros bcas mtshan ma sgom// zas mchog (319)spongs nas zas ngan za ba bzhin// chos nyid ngang nas kun brtags lhan skyes kyi// ma rig la sogs spong bya'i tshogs rnams 'joms/

don la yengs med ji ltar bas kyang grol// bden pa mthong zhing tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'gyur/ mi rtog rang la lha dang sngags ni gnas// ye shes lnga yi ngo bor lhun gyis grub// bsrung sdom med pa dam tshig chen po ste// dkon mchog mchod dang gtor ma'i mchog kyang 'di// sbyin sreg las dang bdud rtsi za ba 'di// phar phyin drug dang grub mtha' kun kyang 'dus// 'di nyid bsgoms pas byang chub sems dpa' ste// dpa' bo dpa' mo rgyang na gnas kyang 'du// go ba nyams dang rtogs pa shar ba las// rtogs pa rgyas pas sdang ba je dag 'gro// spang bya dag pas sku gsum shugs la 'grub// stong rig gsal gsum bzhi yi sku gsum yin// bde gsal mi rtog lam gyi sku gsum mo// mdog dbyibs mtshan ma med pa chos kyi sku// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba longs spyod rdzogs// gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad sogs sprul sku'o// rtog med 'dul bya'i snod kyi khyad par bzhin// 'khrul pa med par chos ston bde gshegs gsung*// yul dang yul can gnas lugs ji lta bar// ma nor mkhyen pa thugs kyi ye shes nyid// me long mnyam nyid sor rtog bya ba grub// chos dbyings ye shes chos sku'i yon tan no// mtshan dpe gzugs sku'i yon tan 'dir ma brjod// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing bzhin du// rtog pa med bzhin don mdzad phrin las yin// snying po'i lam mchog phyag rgya chen po 'di// kun gyis bsgom dang bsgoms nas gzhan dag la// ma nor ston par byed pa zab mo'i lam// ma nor gsal bar rgyud sde'i snying por bshad// phyag rgya chen (320)po'i gdams pa snying po'i gter mdzod rdzogs so// rgyal mtshan dpal gyis go bde bar sbyar ba'o/// /bkra shis bde legs dpal 'byor don grub shog /dge'o// shubham// maṅga laṃ/ ༈ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi gnad yig bzhugs so/

༈ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma mchog /ma nor lam ston chos kyi rjes// gus btud 'gro ba rgyal gyur cig /de gsungs khrid kyi gnad yig bri// thog mar snod bcud rten 'brel gces// brgyud ldan gdams dang nyams rtogs 'dzom// byin rlabs tshan g.yos rang 'dod zad// snying rje'i mdangs can de zhabs gtugs// gzhan du ldongs pa nang sprel bzhin// tshe 'di'i re ltos thag pa bcad// mos gus mchog gyur som nyi med// dad ldan brtson chen rjes su bzung*// gzhan du spra rlon me stag bzhin// 'byung bzhi'i khams dang skye mched dang*// rim gcig thod rgal dbang po yi// rim shes de mthun gdams ngag gdab// gzhan du mun pa mda' 'phen bzhin// lang tsho dri mas phog pa dang*// shed med stobs dang bral ba dang*// bslab nyams don la sred pa dang*// blun rmongs shes rab chung ba dang*// cher sems nga rgyal snyems pa dang*// yon tan mi skyed gdam ngag slong*// gus na cung zad rjes su bzung*// snod bcud 'dzoms pa'i gdams ngag la// nyams myong bzang po'i drod tshad dgos// tshar bcad rjes bzung rang sor bzhag /rnam gsum khrid kyi gnad yin no// snga ma ma tshar phyi ma min// myur la yun thung slob pa'i dus// yun ring 'dod na yun thung 'chor// sgom pa bzang 'dod phug rtsol ngan// mi gtam ngan na yid gnyis skye// mi mthun the tshom skye ba'i rgyu// slus kyis dgos na sgom gnya' 'chag /dad pa chung na khul ro ldangs// (321)brtson 'grus g.yel na sgom pa 'thas// 'dod thag nye na sun pa skyen// brtags spyod byas na don phyir 'chod// zhen 'dod mi dang mi 'phrad do// 'phro na tshar bcad rjes su bzung*// gnas na re med rang sor bzhag /gsal na de 'dod de bsgom lta// ngo sprod sngas na go bar dred/ lhag mthong sngas pas zhi gnas med// gol sa sngas pas zo lhod skye// bogs 'don sngas na sa mi zin// bsgom pa 'gyur na ngo ma sprod// bzang skyed 'dod na ngan skyed che// sha lus 'khrigs na gzer ba'i rtags// khams lus dub na brtson pa slod// bying rgod che na dran shes brten// ma 'thebs pa la log non gces// zhen log mos gus rkang dang mgo

/ma yengs mi sgom gnad du che// ma brtan bar du g.yeng ba spang*// lda med bsgom pa brtan gyin ngan// gsar bu'i sgom pa bsrings kyin thung*// blo dman bsgom pa brtan gyin 'chor// sor 'jog ma shes bcos shing bslad// 'jur la ma thems ngan lang 'chor// brtag spyod bzang 'dod rtsol bas bslad// ngom pas mthong na mtshan mas 'ching*// rnam rtog 'gogs pa'i bsgom chen sdug /ma skyes rdzun gyis rting non yong*// sngar yod rdzun gyis gdam ngag sbed// rang bstod gzhan smod sgom chen sreg /so ma rang mdangs lhug pa gsum// bzhag thabs sgom gyi dngos gzhi yin// rang sems so mar 'jog shes dang*// gsal stong rang ngo mthong ba dang*/ rnam rtog rang ngo shes pa gsum// khrid tshad rab 'bring rnam gsum yin// yid ches rdo rus thug pa dgos// 'khrul 'khor lta stangs kun la gces// bsgom pa dus stos dgos mi slebs// spyod lam ma 'dres yengs mi thub// goms 'dres chung na rkyen khar 'chor// lo gsum bla ma'i drung du bsgom// nyams myong rdzun zhum med par 'bul// gol sa the (322)tshom brdar sha bcad// chig skye pher na ri khrod 'grim// snang rkyen thub na spyod pa bya// yon tan rdzogs na gzhan don 'byung*// tshe gcig sangs rgyas the tshom med// sgom nyes pa dang sgrub nyes pa// ngal ba don med ma byed par// don dam gdams pa'i nyams khrid 'di// rtogs ldan bla ma'i drung du skyongs// 'dra ba mang ste nor nyen che// 'di med chos kun yid smon yin// zab mo khrid kyi gnad yig shākya'i dge slong rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /'di don rtogs shing 'gro la ston par shog /shubhaṃ/ maṅga laṃ// / ༈ /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi ngo sprod bzhugs so/// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod mdor bsdus pa ni// gzhi lam 'bras gsum ste/

de la gzhi'i ngo bo rang gi sems sam rig pa 'di yin te// gru bzhi dang zlum po la sogs pa'i dbyibs dang*// dkar dmar la sogs pa'i kha dog tu grub pa'i rdzas kyi dngos po rdul phran tsam yang mi 'dug pas stong par 'dug /stong pa'i gdangs ma 'gags pa gsal la dwangs pa dri mas gos pa mi 'dug pas gsal bar 'dug /gsal stong de gnyis kyi gshis sam ngo bo rig pa ste// mi 'char dgu 'char yin min shes shing go ba sna tshogs su 'char bar ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa 'di la kun gzhi zhes bya'o// de la gsal rigs stong gsum dbyer med pa ste/ kun gzhi 'dis kun gzhi'i gnas lugs de ngo ma shes pas// kun gzhi ma rig pa'am kun gzhi 'khrul pa ste/ kun gzhi nyid ji ltar 'khrul yang*// kun gzhi'i ngo bo gsal rig stong gsum de ngan du ma song*// rtogs te sangs rgyas kyang bzang du mi 'gro bas kun gzhi zhes bya ste/ kun gzhi kho rang gis kho rang ngo ma shes pas gzung 'dzin sna tshogs par shar// gzugs 'dzin gyi dbang gis (323)las sna tshogs bsags las kyi dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pas// ma dag pa rnam shes kyi kun gzhi zhes bya// bla ma dam pa'i bka' drin gyis lam bsgoms pas// gzhi kho rang gi gnas lugs// kho rang gi rtog pa mthar phyin pas chos sku thob pa ste// chos sku de sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad dang*/ gzugs sku gnyis la sogs thob byed kyi rten byed pas/ dag pa ye shes kyi kun gzhi zhes bya te/ gzhi de gnyis ngo bo gsal rig stong gsum yin pas gcig cing*/ ma rtogs pa'i tshe 'khor ba'i gzhi dang*/ rtogs pa'i tshe mya ngan las 'das pa'i gzhi ste/ rtog pas phye bas kun gzhi gnyis so// lam la lta ba/ sgom pa/ spyod pa gsum te/ lta ba ni chos rnams kyi gnas lugs gtan la 'bebs pa ste/ kun gzhi'i gnas lugs gong du bstan pa de yin la/ de'i gdangs ma 'gags pa yul dang yul can sna tshogs su shar ba ste/

phyi yul gyi snang ba sna tshogs pa thams cad/ rang gi sems nyid de dang der shar ba yin pas// sna tshogs su snang ba sems nyid snang ba ste/ sna tshogs su snang bas sems snang ba'o// snang ba sna tshogs pa de dag la// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i rdzas su grub pas/ mig gis blta rung*/ rna bas thos su rung ba la sogs pa yin la/ kun gzhi la ni/ dbyibs kha dog la sogs pa med pas phyi'i yul snang sna tshogs pa sems ma yin no// des na snang ba sna tshogs pa dang*/ sems gcig pa dang tha dad pa dang gang yang ma yin pa ste/ sems las tha dad pa'i phyi rol gyi yul snang bden par grub pa gcig kyang med do// sems ni dbyibs kha dog gi rdzas su ma grub cing*/ phyi rol gyi yul snang dbyibs kha dog gi rdzas su grub pas gcig pa (324)ma yin te/ rdzas yin pa dang ma yin pa gnyis gcig pa ma yin pa bzhin no// sgom pa ni/ 'das pa'i dus skyid sdug ji ltar byung ba'i bsam blo mi gtong*/ da gzod 'di bya 'di byed kyi gzhig 'grel gyi bsam blo mi gtong*/ da lta 'di bsgom yang yid la mi byed pas te/ 'di bsgom gyi dbyibs gru bzhi zlum po la sogs pa bsgom rgyu med/ 'di bsgom ma yin byas nas dbyibs kha dog gi rnam pa can gang yang spang rgyu med// da ltar gyi sems 'di la bcas bcos med par rang so la 'jog pa yin la// bde gsal mi rtog pa la sogs pa yong la re dang*// ma byung gis dogs pa mi bya/ re dogs gnyis kyis gnas lugs kyi don mthong ba la sgrib pa yin pas/ re dogs mi bya/ rig pa ma bcur ma bsgrims par/ rig pa'i rtsal thon pa'i ngang la/ ma yengs mi bsgom par bskyang*/ de ltar yid la gang yang mi bsam yang*/ rtog pa sna tshogs su 'phro ba na/ yid la rtog par la byung ba de la cher bltas pas/ rtog pa la ngos bzung mi dmigs par stong nyid du 'char te/ rgya mtsho'i chu dwangs pa rlung gis bskyod pas/

chu bur dang rba rlabs su 'char te/ shar yang rgya mtsho'i chu yin pas/ rgya mtsho'i chu las rba rlabs kyi chu ngan rgyu ni med/ rba rlabs kyi chu de las rgya mtsho'i chu bzang rgyu med pa bzhin du/ sems mi rtog par gnas pa las/ bag chags kyi rkyen gyis rnam rtog sna tshogs su 'gyu yang*/ sems nyid rtog par shar ba yin pas/ rtog pa nyid mi rtog pa las ngan rgyu med la/ sems rtog par shar ba yin pas/ rtog pa las mi rtog pa bzang rgyu med pas/ rtog pa la lta go chod na mi rtog par 'char ro// des na mi rtog pa la ched du mi sgrub/ rtog pa la ched du mi 'gegs par dran pa'i rgyun ma shor bar skyong ngo*// de ltar bsgoms pas/ gang yang yid la mi byed pa bsgom pa la brten nas// mi (325)rtog pa rjen ne shar bas/ gsal stong blo bral yid ches la brjod mi shes pa'i rjen pa zhig nang nas shar ba de la lhag mthong gi ye shes zhes bya'o// de la yang zhen pa med par thun gyis gdams ngag gis nyams su blang bar bya'o// spyod pa ni/ mal nas ldangs pa'i dus nyid nas/ mnyam bzhag gi dran pa'i rgyun ma shor ba'i ngang nas ldangs zhing*/ spyod lam gang byed kyang dran thag ma chad par bskyang*/ bzang po'i nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa gang shar kyang zhen pa med par bya/ lus sems kyi thog tu dga' bde ci byung yang*/ zhen chags med par dga' bde'i ngo bo la lta zhing*/ stong nyid du ro mnyam/ lus sems kyi thog tu mi 'dod pa'i na tsha dang sdug bsngal ci byung yang ngo bo la lta zhing*// tshe snga ma'i las ngan yin pas/ las myong bas 'dzad pas/ phyi mar las kyi rnam smin mi myong bas a re dga' snyam du lam du khyer ro// 'bras bu ni/ lta sgom spyod pa gsum nyams su blangs pas sems kyi gnas lugs ngo ma shes glo bur gyi dri ma je dag la song bas/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa la sogs pa lam gyi yon tan thams cad mngon du gyur nas/

sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du sangs rgya'o// zab mo gnad kyi gdams pa ni// bla ma khyung ston rdo rjes bskul ba'i ngor// sgom chen pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos// gshongs chen yangs pa'i gzhal yas khang du bkod pa'o// dge ba 'di yis lho mun pa'i gling gi sems can thams cad la// chos nyid yang dag pa'i nyi ma shar nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /bkra shis bde legs dpal 'bar don grub shog /'di bzhengs dge bas sangs rgyas myur thob shog /maṅga laṃ// shu bham// dge'o/// /(326)
